(schema)  version=1
    markdown: "Coralogix recording rules group set. Recording rules pre-compute frequently used or computationally heavy PromQL expressions into new metrics. For more info please review - https://coralogix.com/docs/user-guides/data-transformation/metric-rules/recording-rules/."
groups  SetNestedAttribute optional computed
    plan modifier: setplanmodifier.useStateForUnknownModifier Once set, the value of this attribute in state will not change.
    validator: schemavalidator.ExactlyOneOfValidator Ensure that one and only one attribute from this collection is set: "[<.yaml_content]"
groups[]  NestedObject
groups[].interval  Int64Attribute optional computed
    description: "How often rules in the group are evaluated (in seconds). Default is 60 seconds."
    plan modifier: int64planmodifier.useStateForUnknownModifier Once set, the value of this attribute in state will not change.
    validator: int64validator.atLeastValidator value must be at least 60
groups[].limit  Int64Attribute optional computed
    description: "Limits the number of alerts an alerting rule and series a recording-rule can produce. 0 is no limit."
    plan modifier: int64planmodifier.useStateForUnknownModifier Once set, the value of this attribute in state will not change.
groups[].name  StringAttribute required
    description: "The (unique) rule-group name."
    validator: stringvalidator.lengthAtLeastValidator string length must be at least 1
groups[].rules  ListNestedAttribute required
groups[].rules[]  NestedObject
groups[].rules[].evaluation_delay_ms  Int64Attribute optional
    description: "Delays the rule's evaluation (in milliseconds) so late-arriving data is ingested first. Must be between 0 and 1800000 (30 minutes). When omitted, no delay is configured; an explicit 0 is a distinct, persisted value. Removing the attribute clears the delay."
    validator: int64validator.betweenValidator value must be between 0 and 1800000
groups[].rules[].expr  StringAttribute required
    description: "The PromQL expression to evaluate. Every evaluation cycle this is evaluated at the current time, and the result recorded as a new set of time series with the metric name as given by 'record'."
groups[].rules[].labels  MapAttribute optional computed elem=basetypes.StringType
    description: "Labels to add or overwrite before storing the result."
    plan modifier: mapplanmodifier.useStateForUnknownModifier Once set, the value of this attribute in state will not change.
groups[].rules[].record  StringAttribute required
    description: "The name of the time series to output to. Must be a valid metric name."
id  StringAttribute computed
    plan modifier: stringplanmodifier.useStateForUnknownModifier Once set, the value of this attribute in state will not change.
name  StringAttribute optional computed
    markdown: "The name of the rule group. Overrides the name specified in the YAML if provided."
    plan modifier: stringplanmodifier.useStateForUnknownModifier Once set, the value of this attribute in state will not change.
yaml_content  StringAttribute optional
    markdown: "YAML specification of rules. Cannot be used together with `groups`. Keys are the lowercased field names (for example the evaluation delay is `evaluationdelayms`). Unrecognized keys are ignored silently, so prefer `groups` if you want your attribute names validated."
    plan modifier: stringplanmodifier.requiresReplaceIfModifier 
    validator: recording_rules.recordingRulesGroupYamlContentValidator validate yaml_content
    validator: schemavalidator.ConflictsWithValidator Ensure that if an attribute is set, these are not set: "[<.groups]"
